item.title: PA Media launches new QuickCheck feed providing real-time context for live news moments - PA Media Group
item.description: PA Media, the UK and Ireland’s national news agency, has launched a new QuickCheck feed within its award-winning content platform, PA Explore. Powered by PA Media’s accredited fact-checking operation, QuickCheck provides broadcasters, platforms and publishers with evidence-backed context, allowing editorial teams to monitor a live feed of concise newsroom-ready updates.
